terra.problem: Saying the chains and the drama didn't stop a thing goes beyond Paul's statement that his circumstances advanced the gospel.
Paul says most of the brothers spoke more boldly, not that nobody went quiet.
The passage does not say the goodwill preachers were out in the open or rule out their preaching in secret.
Papa comments on the question sounding like a trap and refers to the card matching the text.
The passage does not say the Philippians were far away.
The explanation says Christ will be exalted in Paul's body as a certainty. Paul expresses this as his eager expectation and hope.
The coin-flip comparison makes light of Paul's serious tension between living and dying.
Paul says he does not know in verse 22, not a verse earlier than verse 25.
The explanation is generic and repetitive, with little of Papa's personality or teaching.
A batch coming out of the oven together does not match the action of people standing firm and contending together.
The passage does not say the Philippians are not in chains.
